description: A Python module implementing an XML parser with support for XHTML DTDs and various encodings, utilizing xml.etree.ElementTree and xml.parsers.expat.

classes.name: XMLParser
classes.description: A custom XML parser supporting XHTML DTDs and all Python-supported encodings.

methods.name: _wrap_error
methods.description: Wraps and raises an xml.etree.ElementTree.ParseError with additional info.

methods.name: _fixname
methods.description: Fixes and caches tag or attribute names, handling namespace syntax.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the XMLParser with optional encoding, setting up the expat parser and callbacks.

methods.name: _xml_decl
methods.description: Handles XML declaration, setting the read encoding.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Handles start tags, fixing names and attributes.

methods.name: _external
methods.description: Handles external entity references, particularly XHTML DTDs.

methods.name: _skipped
methods.description: Handles skipped entities, raising an error for undefined entities.

methods.name: feed
methods.description: Feeds data into the parser, handling multi-byte encoding issues.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes parsing and returns the parsed XML tree.
